title.zh: 把 presence channel 抽成 concern
title.en: Extract presence channel into a concern

zh: 读取 app/channels/presence_channel.rb
发现 3 个回调共用同一套心跳
起草 app/models/concerns/presence.rb
迁移 subscribed / unsubscribed hooks
旧路径上的 specs 仍然通过
等待：按 channel 类型拆，还是一个 concern？
en: Reading app/channels/presence_channel.rb
Found 3 callbacks sharing the same heartbeat
Drafting app/models/concerns/presence.rb
Moving subscribed / unsubscribed hooks
Specs still pass on the old path
Waiting: split by channel type, or one concern?

text.zh: 这个 concern 快到 400 行了。按 channel 类型拆，还是留一个文件？
text.en: This concern is heading toward 400 lines. Split by channel type, or keep one file?

title.zh: 重写 ISO 构建脚本，改成流式日志
title.en: Rewrite ISO builder to stream logs

zh: 分析 build.sh — 11 分钟，其中 4 分钟完全静默
用行缓冲 logger 替换 tee
mkarchiso 仍然吞掉 pacstrap 输出
修补 chroot hook
在 comet-a 上 dry-run 看起来干净
musl 测试镜像的 glibc pin 失败了
en: Profiling build.sh — 11 minutes, silent for 4 of them
Replacing tee with a line-buffered logger
mkarchiso still swallows pacstrap output
Patching the chroot hook
Dry-run on comet-a looks clean
musl test image failed the glibc pin

text.zh: musl 上测试失败。在 chroot 里钉死 glibc，还是跳过 musl 镜像？
text.en: Tests fail on musl. Pin glibc in the chroot, or skip the musl image?

title.zh: 给写信框加上键盘快捷键
title.en: Add keyboard shortcuts to the composer

zh: 梳理当前只能点的工具栏
在 Stimulus 里起草 keymap
Cmd-Enter 已经能发送 — 好
Vim 用户会恨用 Ctrl-K 插链接
尝试只在写信框里用 Space 当 leader
和格式栏的冲突还在
en: Mapping the current click-only toolbar
Drafting a keymap in Stimulus
Cmd-Enter already sends — good
Vim users will hate Ctrl-K for links
Trying Space as a leader in the composer only
Collision with the format bar remains

text.zh: 快捷键和 Vim 冲突。写信框里用 Space 当 leader？
text.en: The shortcut collides with Vim. Use Space as leader inside the composer?

zh: 用 America/Sao_Paulo + 夏令时复现
全天事件存成 UTC 午夜
ICS 导出后客人那边错了一天
先写一条会失败的 spec
应该用 floating dates，不是带时区的 timestamp
需要决定全天事件和定时事件怎么分
en: Reproducing with America/Sao_Paulo + DST
All-day events stored as midnight UTC
ICS export shifts them a day for the guest
Writing a failing spec first
Floating dates, not zoned timestamps
Need a call on all-day vs timed events

text.zh: 全天事件改存 floating dates，还是继续 UTC 并写进文档？
text.en: Store all-day events as floating dates, or keep UTC and document the quirk?

title.en: Design the new packing slip PDF

Type is too small at warehouse light
Bumping body to 11pt, keeping the mark
QR now sits above the SKU block
Need a second page for kits
Waiting on the fold line

text.zh: 套装一页放不下。允许第二张，还是把格子缩小？
text.en: Kits overflow one page. Allow a second sheet, or shrink the grid?

Grouping: ISO, theming, hardware, docs
Dropping the noisy dependency bumps
Draft in markdown, ready for review
Title case vs sentence case — matching the last one
Done. Sitting in CHANGELOG.md

text.en: Lead with hardware support, or with the ISO streaming logs?

Adding a pane-aware lazygit command

Pinned the working tree to the pane's repo
Ready for a review pass

comet-a / comet-b already resolve
omarchy-1 still shows as a random node

Need ACL so only the laptop SSHs in
Waiting on the tag

en: glkvm.local only works on the desk VLAN
Installing Tailscale on the Comet
Browser UI comes up on 100.x
HDMI capture is 4K30 — fine for BIOS
USB keyboard latency is 40ms
Need a call: cloud relay or tailnet only?

text.zh: KVM 只暴露在 tailnet，还是也走 GL.iNet 云？
text.en: Expose the KVM on the tailnet only, or also via GL.iNet cloud?

title.zh: Neovim 不再写代码，只用来 review
title.en: Stop writing code in Neovim — keep it for review

zh: 删掉我从不触发的 snippet 包
留下 telescope、gitsigns、lazygit
用 oil.nvim 逛 agent 刚动过的目录

Keeping telescope, gitsigns, lazygit
Oil.nvim for walking the tree the agent just touched
LSP stays for jump-to-def while reading
Copilot off — the agents are the copilot
Config is quieter. Ready to source.

text.zh: 阅读时保留 LSP，还是拆掉、全靠 agent？
text.en: Leave LSP on for reading, or strip it and rely on the agent?

en: Labeling 140 threads from overnight
Bugs vs billing vs 'it just works' praise
Drafting 12 replies, none sent
One thread looks like a real outage
Holding that one for a human
The rest are ready to glance

text.en: Send the 12 drafts, or keep them in Review?
